references.text: Parallel account in Joshua where Caleb gives the same promise of his daughter Achsah to whoever captures Kiriath-Sepher
Caleb is mentioned as a faithful servant who followed the Lord wholeheartedly, background for his position and authority
Caleb receives Hebron as an inheritance, context for his conquests and promises regarding Kiriath-Sepher
Jacob had to serve to get Rachel as his wife, a similar pattern where a man must perform a task to win a woman in marriage
Saul promised his daughter to whoever killed Goliath, the same pattern of promising a daughter as a reward for military victory
Saul offered his daughter Merab to David for his bravery in battle, parallel to Caleb's offer
